Wholesale Solutions

Tailored for high standards and high volume

Whether you are opening a new Cape Town espresso bar or upgrading an existing commercial venue, we support your entire coffee operation.

1. Fresh Roastery Supply

Weekly scheduled roasting of our signature blends (Vreugde, Imani, Mi Amor, Gracia) and single origins. Packaged in 1kg degassing-valve bags with guaranteed delivery schedules across Cape Town.

Explore our roasts ↗

2. Commercial Machinery

Authorized importers and distributors of commercial 2-group espresso machines (Wega Rover), commercial on-demand grinders (Mythos Iris), Flojet bottled water pumps, and Lebrew batch brewers.

View commercial machines ↗

3. Turnkey Café Launch

From your City of Cape Town Certificate of Acceptability (CoA) 1:50 layout plans to shopfitting, staff training, and Odoo POS deployment, we build turnkey coffee businesses.
